title: Chandena10,11,
text: 3 Yam bhikkhave aniccaṃ tatra vo chando pahātabbo || rāgo pahātabbo || chandarāgo pahātabbo || || Kiñca bhikkhave aniccaṃ || || 4 Rūpā bhikkhave aniccā tatra vo chando pahātabbo || rāgo pahātabbo || chandarāgo pahātabbo || || 5-8 Saddā || || Gandhā || || Rasā || || Phoṭṭhabbā || || 9 Dhammā aniccā tatra vo chando pahātabbo || rāgo pahātabbo || chandarāgo pahātabbo || || 10 Yam bhikkhave aniccam tatra vo chando pahātabbo || rāgo pahātabbo || chandarāgo pahātabbo || ||
